topic: Calling to Cancel a Streaming Subscription

script.title: CANCEL OR PAUSE
script.scene_zh: 客服電話 · 退訂溝通
script.story_hook: One subscription, one brave phone call.
script.intro_zh: 一份訂閱，一通勇敢的退訂電話。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to today's phone scene. Listen for polite ways to quit a service.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的電話場景。留意如何禮貌又堅定地退訂服務。
script.outro: And that's a cancellation handled kindly. Pause now, decide later, no pressure.
script.outro_zh: 一通退訂電話就這樣溫和地收尾。先暫停，之後再決定，毫無壓力。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: I watched one show in March
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her mid twenties with black hair in two long braids, small gold hoop earrings, an oversized purple hoodie, cozy striped socks, and a tall slim build
script.char_b_description: a cheerful man in his forties with closely cropped salt-and-pepper hair, rectangular glasses, a light blue office shirt with rolled sleeves, a headset with microphone, and an average build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, I'm calling to cancel my subscription.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ aɪm ˈkɔ.lɪŋ tə ˈkæn.səl maɪ ˌsʌb.skrɪpˈʃən/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我打電話來是想取消訂閱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for calling, and I'm sorry to hear that.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ kɔ.lɪŋ ænd aɪm ˈsɑɹ.i tə hɪɹ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 感謝來電，很遺憾聽到這個消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly? I watched one show in March.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑ.nəst.li aɪ wɑtʃt wʌn ʃoʊ ɪn mɑɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 老實講，我整個三月只看過一部劇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough. May I ask your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf me aɪ æsk jɔɹ neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 合理。請問您的大名？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Dana Okafor, D-A-N-A.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈdeɪ.nə oʊˈkɑ.fɔɹ ˈdi eɪ ɛn eɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我是 Dana Okafor，D-A-N-A。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, Dana. And the email on file?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈdeɪ.nə ænd ði ˈi.meɪl ɑn faɪl/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，Dana。註冊信箱是哪一個？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's dana.o at fastmail dot com.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈdæ.nə oʊ æt ˈfæst.meɪl dɑt kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 是 dana.o，圈 a，fastmail 點 com。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found you. You're on the fifteen ninety-nine plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ju jʊɹz ɑn ðə ˌfɪfˈtin ˈnɪn.ti naɪn plæn/
dialogue.zh: 找到您了。您用的是一個月十五塊九毛九的方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, why does that number sound bigger now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm waɪ dʌz ðæt ˈnʌm.bɚ saʊnd ˈbɪɡ.ɚ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這個數字怎麼聽起來變大了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There was a price change in January, I'm sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹ wəz ə praɪs tʃeɪndʒ ɪn ˈdʒæn.ju.ɛ.ɹi aɪm ˈsɑɹ.i/
dialogue.zh: 一月份調過價，真的很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that's okay. Can I hear the options?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæts oʊˈkeɪ kən aɪ hɪɹ ði ˈɑp.ʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 沒事沒事。可以告訴我有哪些選項嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can cancel, pause, or switch to a cheaper plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ˈkæn.səl pɔz ɔɹ swɪtʃ tə ə ˈtʃi.pɚ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 您可以取消、暫停，或改用更便宜的方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cancel first, please. I mean, that's my goal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæn.səl fɝst pliz aɪ min ðæts maɪ ɡoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 先講取消這事吧，我是說，那才是目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally your call. Mind if I check one thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊ.ə.li jɔɹ kɔl maɪnd ɪf aɪ tʃɛk wʌn θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 一切聽您的。介意我查一件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 請便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, um, today is the ninth, so you're fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʌm təˈdeɪ ɪz ðə naɪnθ soʊ jʊɹz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，今天是九號，所以您還不緊急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine how? Do I still get charged today?
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn haʊ du aɪ stɪl ɡɛt tʃɑɹd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不緊急是指？今天還會不會扣錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, billing is the fourteenth, five days away.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈbɪ.lɪŋ ɪz ðə fɔɹˈtiːnθ faɪv deɪz əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不會，帳單日是十四號，還有五天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, thank you for noticing that detail.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋk ju fɚ ˈnoʊ.tɪ.sɪŋ ðæt ˈdi.teɪl/
dialogue.zh: 噢，謝謝你留意到這個細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my job, and honestly my favorite part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ dʒɑb ænd ˈɑ.nəst.li maɪ ˈfeɪ.vɚ.ɪt pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的工作，也是我最喜歡的環節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, okay, so about that cancel button.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊˈkeɪ soʊ əˈbaʊt ðæt ˈkæn.səl ˈbʌt.ən/
dialogue.zh: 哈，好，來說說那個取消按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me guess — you tapped it five times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛt mi ˈɡɛs ju ˈtæpt ɪt ˈfaɪv ˈtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 讓我猜——您已經按了它五次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven. It just spins and laughs at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛv.ən ɪt dʒʌst spɪnz ænd læfs æt mi/
dialogue.zh: 七次。它只會轉圈，像在笑我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it's shy about leaving, we'll handle it here.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪts ʃaɪ əˈbaʊt ˈli.vɪŋ wil ˈhæn.dəl ɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，它捨不得走，我在這裡替您辦好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can truly finish the cancellation right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ˈtɹuː.li ˈfɪn.ɪʃ ðə ˌkæn.səˈleɪ.ʃən raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你真的能現在就把取消處理完嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one formality: do you want to pause instead?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn fɔɹˈmæl.ə.ti du ju wɑnt tə pɔz ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 能，只有一個例行問題：要不要考慮暫停？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pause? Like, the account just sleeps?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔz laɪk ði əˈkaʊnt dʒʌst slips/
dialogue.zh: 暫停？意思是帳號先去睡覺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, zero charges, and it wakes up anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæk.li ˈzɪɹ.oʊ ˈtʃɑɹ.dʒəz ænd ɪt weɪks ʌp ˈɛn.iˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，完全不收費，而且隨時能醒來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh. How long can I leave it asleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ haʊ lɔŋ kən aɪ liv ɪt əˈslip/
dialogue.zh: 喔。它最多可以睡多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to three months, then we'd ask you to choose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌp tə θri ˈmʌn.θɪz ðɛn wɪd ˈæsk ju tə ˈtʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 最多三個月，之後再請您做選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I could finish my show in April.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kʊd ˈfɪn.ɪʃ maɪ ʃoʊ ɪn ˈeɪ.prəl/
dialogue.zh: 這樣我就能四月把劇追完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the dream, yes, no guilt, no fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈdrim jɛs ˈnoʊ ˈɡɪlt ˈnoʊ ˈfi/
dialogue.zh: 理想正是如此，不心懷愧疚，也不花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, tempting, um, but what's the cheaper plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈtɛmp.tɪŋ ʌm bʌt wʌts ðə ˈtʃi.pɚ plæn/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，挺誘人，嗯，那便宜方案長怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six fifty with ads on some shows.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈfɪf.ti wɪð ædz ɑn sʌm ʃoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 六塊五，部分節目帶有廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ads in the middle of scenes? I'd rage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ædz ɪn ðə ˈmɪ.dəl əv sinz aɪd reɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 廣告會插在劇情中間？我會抓狂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only between scenes, I promise, no mid-scene evil.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊn.li bɪˈtwin sinz aɪ ˈprɑm.ɪs noʊ mɪd sin ˈiː.vəl/
dialogue.zh: 只在場次之間跳出來，我保證，劇情中途絕無廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, downloads? My plane wifi is terrible.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ˈdaʊn.loʊdz maɪ pleɪn ˈwaɪ.faɪ ɪz ˈtɛɹ.ə.bəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那離線下載呢？我飛機上的 wifi 超爛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ad plan keeps two downloads at a time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æd plæn kips tu ˈdaʊn.loʊdz æt ə taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 含廣告方案可以同時存兩集離線看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two is honestly plenty, I never use more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪz ˈɑ.nəst.li ˈplɛn.ti aɪ ˈnɛv.ɚ juz mɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 兩集其實就很夠，我從來用不完更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most folks say that, then travel a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst foʊks seɪ ðæt ðɛn ˈtræv.əl ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 大多數人都是這麼講，然後到處飛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, guilty. So, pause or downgrade, um...
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈɡɪl.ti soʊ pɔz ɔɹ ˈdaʊn.ɡreɪd ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 哈，讓你說中了。那，暫停還是降級，嗯……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, what does your calendar say for spring?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl wʌt dʌz jɔɹ ˈkæl.ən.dɚ seɪ fɚ sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，您春天的行程怎麼安排？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Busy, so busy, trips in March and May.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪ.zi soʊ ˈbɪ.zi trɪps ɪn mɑɹtʃ ænd meɪ/
dialogue.zh: 超忙，三月跟五月都要出遠門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this month is quiet, right? Between shows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs mʌnθ ɪz ˈkwaɪ.ət raɪt bɪˈtwin ʃoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 那這個月反倒是空檔，對吧？劇與劇之間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yeah... okay, pause it for three months, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛ oʊˈkeɪ pɔz ɪt fɚ θri mʌn.θɪz pliz/
dialogue.zh: 是啊……好，請先暫停三個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, um, confirmation email, is this inbox good?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌm ˌkɑn.fɚˈmeɪ.ʃən ˈi.meɪl ɪs ðɪs ˈɪn.bɑks ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 辦好了。嗯，確認郵件寄到這個信箱行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and can you repeat the reference number?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd kæn ju ɹiˈpit ðə ˈrɛf.ɚ.əns ˈnʌm.bɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，麻煩再報一次參考編號好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: C-four, seven, two, X, that's the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /si fɔɹ ˈsɛv.ən tu ɛks ðæts ðə koʊd/
dialogue.zh: C 四、七、二、X，就是這組代碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it written. So nothing gets charged, ever?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈrɪt.ən soʊ ˈnʌθ.ɪŋ ɡɛts tʃɑɹd ˈɛv.ɚ/
dialogue.zh: 記下來了。所以這段時間完全不會扣錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero until March, then you choose again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈzɪɹ.oʊ ʌnˈtɪl mɑɹtʃ ðɛn ju tʃuz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 三月之前都是零費用，到時再由您決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know, this call was weirdly pleasant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ ðɪs kɔl wəz ˈwɪɾd.li ˈplɛz.ənt/
dialogue.zh: 講真的，這通電話愉快得不太正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I cancel things myself, I get the pain.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ ˈkæn.səl θɪŋz maɪˈsɛlf aɪ ɡɛt ðə peɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我自己平常也得退訂閱，懂那種心情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which service did you leave last?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈsɝ.vəs dɪd ju liv læst/
dialogue.zh: 你上一次退掉的是哪一家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A recipe box, my kitchen lost the war.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈrɛs.ə.pi bɑks maɪ ˈkɪtʃ.ən lɔst ðə wɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 是訂閱寄到家的食譜盒，我的廚房打了敗仗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, take care of that kitchen, agent.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ teɪk kɛɹ əv ðæt ˈkɪtʃ.ən ˈeɪ.dʒənt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，好好照顧你的廚房吧，客服先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will. Anything else for you today?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwɪl ˈɛn.i.θɪŋ ɛls fɚ ju təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。今天還有其他要辦的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, that's everything, you've been great, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp ðæts ˈɛv.ɹi.θɪŋ jun bɪn ɡɹeɪt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 沒了，這樣就齊全，你幫了大忙，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for twelve years with us, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ twɛlv jɪɹz wɪð ʌs ˈtɹuː.li/
dialogue.zh: 也謝謝您這十二年的相伴，真心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve years? Okay now I feel old, bye.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv jɪɹz oʊˈkeɪ naʊ aɪ fil oʊld baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 十二年？喔不，我瞬間覺得自己老了，再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Dana, the pause button never judges.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈdeɪ.nə ðə pɔz ˈbʌt.ən ˈnɛv.ɚ ˈdʒʌdʒ.əz/
dialogue.zh: 再見 Dana，暫停按鈕永遠不評判任何人。

script.youtube_title: 【退訂找不到按鈕😤】「我整個三月只看過一部劇」退訂・暫停・降級全對話☎️📱💸｜聽完就能自己打｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Canceling a Subscription
script.youtube_title_en: "I Watched One Show in March" — Calling to Cancel a Streaming Subscription
script.youtube_description:
「老實講，我整個三月只看過一部劇」——想取消訂閱，卻在 App 裡找不到那個取消按鈕？這一集用 60 句連續電話對話，完整重現一通美式客服退訂電話。

你會聽到：撥通後的自我介紹與帳戶核對；得知漲價時的語氣與回應；帳單日與扣款時間的反覆確認；客服順口提出的隱藏版選項：暫停訂閱；含廣告低價方案的細節：廣告位置、離線下載數量；最後拿到確認郵件與參考編號的收尾問句。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，重現電話兩端最真實的美式語感：um、well、so、huh、yeah。聽完你就會用：I'm calling to cancel...、May I ask...、Do I still get charged?、Can you repeat...?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"I watched one show in March" — so why keep paying for the whole library? This 60-line immersive listening practice is a full phone call to cancel a streaming subscription, retention pitch and all.

You will hear: account verification on the phone, reacting to a quiet price hike, confirming the billing date before you're charged, the pause option nobody tells you about, the ad-plan tradeoffs, and wrapping up with a confirmation email and reference code.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with real phone small talk: um, well, so, huh, yeah. By the end you'll own phrases like I'm calling to cancel..., Do I still get charged?, and Can you repeat the reference number?

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.
